page.layout: One column of running text, full width. No margin notes. Page number at the top left. Running head at the top, ornamental and only partly legible. Catchword at the foot ("Infir-") is hyphenated, so it is part of the text.

main_text.p: quoque eius heredes pupil-li sint. Atque hoc non alie-num est, quod ad multa per-tineat, ne aut nusquam, aut usquequaque dicatur, hic admonere. Sunt causæ, quæ plures res habent rationes in simplici constitutione: quod fit, cum id quod factum est, aut quod defenditur, pluribus de causis rectum aut probabile videri potest: ut in hac ipsa causa supponatur enim [?]abheredib. Hæc ratio: Vnius enim pecuniæ plures dissimilibus de causis heredes esse non possunt: nec unquam factum est, ut eiusdem pecuniæ alius testamento, alius lege heres esset. In-fir-

page.notes: The sequence of short lines on this page is set with a printed » at the start of each line, which looks like a quotation or marking device rather than text; it is not transcribed. "abheredib" is my best reading of the line-end "abhe" and the next line's "redib."; it is uncertain and marked [?]. The running head is decorative and I could not read it. "plu" and "abhe" end their lines with no printed hyphen, so they are written whole. The page ends mid-word at "In-fir-", which is kept as a fragment.
